transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to discuss the overhead crane in the fabrication area. I understand there's a cracked mounting bracket that needs to be welded before any high-load lifts, and we've got steel frame production scheduled for tomorrow's day shift. I'd like to get the crane repair scheduled and go through the pre-job review so I can issue the hot work authorization. Can maintenance and EHS walk me through the work scope, production impact, and safety controls?
